title: Early Termination Option Rider — Schedule of Lease Term Agreement Program Terms
content:
The Early Termination Option lets a resident end a Lease Term Agreement before its end date for a fixed fee. This rider schedule states, per term program, whether the option exists, its fee multiple of the contracted monthly rent, its minimum notice, how far into the term it opens, its balance condition, when the fee is due, how long a quote stays valid, and the job relocation and home purchase clauses with their replacement multiples.

## Part 1 — availability, fee multiple and timing

| Term program | Option available | Fee (multiple of the contracted monthly rent) | Minimum notice (calendar days from the signed request to the termination date) | Months of the term elapsed before exercise | No past-due balance required | Fee due within (calendar days of signing) | Quote valid for (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | No | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | Yes | 0 | 14 |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | No | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | Yes | 0 | 14 |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | Yes | 1.50 | 30 | 3 | Yes | 10 | 14 |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | Yes | 2.00 | 60 | 6 | Yes | 10 | 14 |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | Yes | 2.00 | 60 | 6 | Yes | 10 | 14 |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | Yes | 2.50 | 60 | 6 | Yes | 10 | 14 |

The quote validity of 14 calendar days applies to early termination and transfer quotes alike.

## Part 2 — job relocation and home purchase clauses

| Term program | Job relocation clause | Minimum distance of the new workplace (miles) | Fee multiple under job relocation | Home purchase clause | Fee multiple under home purchase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | No | 0 | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | No | 0 | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | No | 0 | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | Yes | 50 | 1.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | Yes | 50 | 1.00 | Yes | 1.00 |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | Yes | 50 | 1.25 | Yes | 1.25 |

Where a clause shows Yes, its multiple is the one that replaces the program's fee multiple when the clause applies; where it shows No, the clause does not exist on that program.

## Reading the rider (hypothetical)

- A Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) program carries an option fee of 2.50 times the contracted monthly rent, a job relocation multiple of 1.25 for a new workplace at least 50 miles away and a home purchase multiple of 1.25.
- A Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) program opens the option after 3 months of the term and asks for 30 calendar days of notice; it has neither clause.
- On a Month-to-Month Agreement or a Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) the option is not available.
